transport.base_url: parent supplied authorized OpenAI-compatible endpoint only
transport.credentials: parent supplied; no historic credential discovery

messages.content: public RTL or generated summary or proposal context

transport.retries: At most two content/schema attempts per stage; all attempts consumed. No HTTP/transport/denial retry. Stop on truncated responses.
transport.token_counting: Parent must confirm byte-BPE tokenization with <=256 chat-framing/hidden-input tokens. All messages ASCII; visible ASCII byte count plus 256 is conservatively capped at 4096. Otherwise this profile cannot run.
transport.completion_requirement: max_tokens must cap all billable generated tokens at640; no extra unbounded reasoning tokens

public_input_categories.source: seven independently authored public educational Verilog files committed at source SHA
public_input_categories.module_summary_to_design_summary: generated six-field JSON, no private RTL or external paths
public_input_categories.proposal_context: Public generated FIR3 design summary; eight legal Yosys/ABC configurations; selected prior top3 within-circuit normalized QoR ratios from freshly rebuilt matched-native bank; up to3 preceding fresh target observations; objective and seed. No historical target/posthoc oracle.
public_input_categories.excluded: No credentials, .env, private keys, private RTL, user files, other projects or posthoc target archive enter payload

summary_values: Nonempty concise string, at most256 characters per field; exact keys
proposal_validation: exact keys, legal config, untried; no heuristic fallback
embedding: Existing canonical all-MiniLM-L6-v2, local CPU only; no embedding endpoint, no local LLM. 384-dimensional L2-normalized vectors; max_seq_length256 with untruncated input length recorded.
evidence: Raw prompt/completion and attempt reservations; usage/timing/model ID; invalid content and transport failure records; native tool versions; CEC plus independent256-vector checks. No credential or provider error body logging.

token_budget_upper_estimate.note: Conservative sum of input4096+output640 per attempt; provider usage records actual counts

preparation_eda_budget.backend_policy: Same pinned Yosys and explicit ABC for mapping/CEC as future pilot; do not pool old Debian QoR.
